script: Export import business in Bangladesh just got three more years. Use them.
The UN moved LDC graduation to 2029, so duty-free perks stay for now.
One: lock in EU and UK buyers. Two: get compliance certificates ready.
Three: price without cash incentives; they will fade.
Then list your company on Exportain and let buyers find you.
